attribution.method: Self costs sum exactly to whole-process summary. Function inclusive cost is self plus recorded outgoing call-edge costs; nested inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed. Inlined instructions are charged to their containing emitted function, so absence of a source helper symbol does not prove zero work.
